text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"\"Have you ever wondered...\" opening and clear \"I believe they would be a great development\" claim","quality":"engaging introduction","description":"It opens with a hook and quickly states a clear position, which gives the argument a more effective entry point."},{"evidence":"\"First...\" and \"Lastly...\" paragraphs with topic sentences","quality":"organizational control","description":"It uses a clearer paragraph structure to guide the reader through separate reasons supporting the claim."},{"evidence":"accidents caused by \"drunk drivers or people not paying attention\" and \"could save lives\"","quality":"concrete support","description":"It connects the source to specific real-world benefits in a way that makes the reasons feel more convincing."},{"evidence":"\"could help improve public transportation\" and \"run a lot faster and smoother\"","quality":"development of ideas","description":"It develops each point by explaining how driverless cars would work and why that matters."},{"evidence":"\"In conclusion...\" restatement plus final reflective sentence","quality":"concluding effectiveness","description":"It ends by restating the argument and leaving the reader with a positive final thought."}]}
